title: At the Zoo
description: Three short recordings about animals at the zoo.
instructions: Read the questions first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Arriving at the zoo
parts.intro: You will hear Sam and his mum at the zoo.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Mum, look! The zoo is so big!

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Yes! What animal do you want to see first?

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: The elephant, please!

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: OK. It is near the lake.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Great! I love elephants.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Hold my hand, Sam. There are many people here.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: OK, Mum. I am not afraid.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I like animals. They are my favourite thing in the world.

parts.title: Part 2 · The animals
parts.intro: You will hear Sam talking about the animals.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: The elephant is very big and grey.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: The monkeys are funny. They eat bananas.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I am afraid of the snake. It is long.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: The zoo is very noisy and very fun.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I want to come back again next year.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Tigers and lions are very strong, but they are kind to their babies.

parts.title: Part 3 · The zoo shop
parts.intro: You will hear Sam and a girl in the zoo shop.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hello, Sam! Do you like the zoo?

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Yes! I see a lion and a tiger.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I want a toy penguin.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I want a toy monkey. It is three pounds.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Let us buy them!

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: The shop is open until the afternoon.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Good. We have enough time to look at everything.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: My mum is waiting outside. She will be happy to see them.
